findings.message: Outside this check: words.w8.sources lists mw-kala and mw-bhairava, and words.w8.components[].sense cites MW 'kāla' (black; time) and 'bhairava' (N. of a form of Śiva; frightful, terrible), but neither file is in research/kalabhairava-ashtakam/v4/sources/. Only mw-kalabhairava.md is there ('a form of Bhairava'). The breakdown of the name in w8.notes looks right by standard lexicography, but the evidence folder doesn't back it. A human should add the excerpts or confirm the sources.
